title: AI-Enabled Cybersecurity Operations
summary: An overview of leveraging AI platforms to streamline security alert processing, risk prioritization, automated response, and governance.

scenes.narration: Modern organisations face overwhelming security alerts across endpoints, cloud systems, and networks, creating critical delays and analyst workload overload.
scenes.visual_concept: Presenter standing beside a digital display showing incoming alert streams from cloud, network, and endpoint nodes.

scenes.narration: An AI-enabled platform continuously analyzes event streams, filtering noise and grouping related alerts into meaningful incidents.
scenes.visual_concept: An AI core processing multi-source data streams, reducing visual noise and clustering correlated alerts into incident cards.

scenes.narration: Incidents are prioritized using risk scores calculated from asset criticality, alert severity, and anomalous behavioral patterns.
scenes.visual_concept: A risk scoring dashboard weighing key factors to elevate high-priority incidents for immediate investigation.

scenes.narration: Automated playbooks isolate affected endpoints and block connections, while maintaining mandatory human approval for sensitive actions.
scenes.visual_concept: Flow diagram showing automated response playbooks executing containment actions with a human checkpoint.

scenes.narration: Target metrics aim to reduce detection time from forty-five to fifteen minutes, and response time from ninety to thirty minutes.
scenes.visual_concept: A comparative metric chart illustrating target reductions in mean time to detect and mean time to respond.

scenes.narration: Governance requires logged decisions, role-based access, data protection, and continuous review of model outputs for false positives.
scenes.visual_concept: A central governance shield surrounded by activity audit logs, role-based access keys, and model review indicators.

scenes.narration: Implementation proceeds in four stages: connect data sources, establish detection rules, introduce AI prioritisation, and activate response playbooks.
scenes.visual_concept: A progressive four-stage roadmap layout spanning data connection, rule definition, AI scoring, and playbook execution.

scenes.narration: This strategy improves visibility, shortens response cycles, reduces repetitive analyst work, and creates a consistent incident handling process.
scenes.visual_concept: A balanced summary grid displaying core operational improvements across visibility, speed, productivity, and consistency.
